activity-date.narrative: RA 1.7 Offtakers, other VC actors, and SMEs co-created and aligned with specific commitments to meet market volumes and demands. A plan per season was developed to promote off-take commitment and local sourcing among value chain actors. Off-take planning and production planning were done mainly between producers and off-takers. Off-takers outlined their various sourcing volumes and demands for various seasons and the required quality needed. This was to help inform and guide producers on the market specifications and demands per season so they could plan their production for the coming season to suit the off-take of buyers. This off-take planning and production planning was done at the two clusters covering all 16 regions. The offtake and production planning resulted in unearthing the fact that 40 trucks of tomatoes are needed in Ghana, especially in the minor season. And that of onions needs 15 trucks daily. This allowed the producers to produce to meet that demand
